evidence.title: Show separately Alert.read-authorized Incident origin in existing read-only Incident Detail
evidence.goal: Restore the canonical Incident upstream Alert triage source to the real Command Incident Detail, using two narrow server-authorized Command owners: relation owner and independent Alert.read owner. Show limited source provenance, no raw Signal/Event, no mutation or permission inheritance.
outputs: One existing Incident Detail shows source Alert ID, source severity/status/disposition/provenance only if source owner independently allows Alert.read
Fail-closed bounded multi-source join with per-Alert isolation, nil/denied omissions and HTML escaping
Synthetic localhost Go HTTP tests exercising independent principal rights and regression behavior
acceptance_tests: Analyst who can read selected Incident and Alert sees actual source-origin fields in Detail; commander who can read Incident but not Alert sees no source ID or attributes
Wrong tenant/env/Incident link, duplicated/bad Alert IDs, malformed owner source/status/provenance/time or source failure abort without leaking prior authorized page content
One denied Alert among authorized references is omitted without disclosing its reference, while authorized Alert stays visible
Legacy owner without either optional interface remains functional, with explicit unavailable source message
Existing Work Queue, Incident Detail and same-origin host tests plus GitHub Actions on exact SHA pass; all obligatory security and statement coverage gates retained
Direct synthetic adapters prove a readable Incident cannot expose related Alert to Incident-only commander, unknown principal, foreign tenant/environment, unexpected Alert or canceled read

rules: Strict tenant isolation and permission checking
